title: Distinguish live, neutral, and earth wires

seo.title: Live, neutral & earth wires — Class 10 Science (Physics)

hook.scenario: Ghar mein jab kisi naye AC ya geyser ka plug dekhte ho, toh usme teen (3) pins hote hain aur andar 3 alag colors ke wires hote hain.
hook.question: In 3 wires ka alag alag kaam kya hai?

mental_model.intuition: Live wire power laata hai, neutral wire power wapas le jata hai (circuit complete karta hai), aur earth wire ek safety net (seatbelt) ki tarah hai jo shock se bachata hai.
mental_model.description: Domestic circuit mein power company se do main taar aate hain. Ek mein 220V ka high voltage (live) hota hai, aur doosra zero voltage (neutral) par hota hai. Teesri taar (earth) sidha zameen ke andar ek plate se judi hoti hai shock absorption ke liye.

explanation:
Humaare gharon mein jo bijli aati hai, woh main supply se generally teen taaron (wires) ke through connect hoti hai: Live wire, Neutral wire, aur Earth wire. Inka color coding system kafi strictly follow kiya jata hai taaki electricians inhe easily pehchaan sakein.

1. Live Wire (Positive): Isko traditionally Red, aur naye conventions ke hisaab se Brown color ka insulation diya jata hai. Yeh electricity ko power station se appliances tak lata hai aur typically 220 V par operate karta hai (in India).

2. Neutral Wire (Negative): Iska color traditionally Black, ya aajkal Blue hota hai. Yeh circuit ko complete karne ka raasta hai, yani current wapas main station ki taraf isi se flow karta hai. Iska potential zero volt (0 V) hota hai. Isliye, live aur neutral ke beech ka potential difference (220 - 0) = 220 V hota hai.

3. Earth Wire: Yeh hamesha Green ya Yellow color ka hota hai. Yeh appliance ko chalane mein koi help nahi karta, balki safety ke liye hota hai. Yeh wire humare ghar ke bahar zameen (earth) mein dabi ek metal plate se juda hota hai. Agar kabhi galti se live wire aapke metallic fridge ya iron ki body se touch ho jaye (leakage), toh current earth wire ke through seedhe zameen mein chala jata hai aur insaan ko ek severe electric shock lagne se bach jata hai.

key_points.title: Live Wire (Red/Brown)
key_points.detail: Carries the current from the supply. At 220V.

key_points.title: Earth Wire (Green/Yellow)
key_points.detail: Connected to a metallic body of appliances for safety against electric shocks.

worked_example.problem: What is the usual colour of the insulation of the earth wire and the live wire in domestic circuits?

steps.narration: Standards ke mutabik colors fix kiye gaye hain taaki wiring mistakes se bacha ja sake.
Earth nature se relate karta hai isliye green, aur live danger se relate karta hai isliye red.

worked_example.answer: Earth wire is Green (or Yellow) and Live wire is Red (or Brown).

worked_example.problem: Explain why metallic body appliances like an electric iron or toaster always have a three-pin plug instead of a two-pin plug.

steps.narration: Metallic bodies current easily conduct karti hain agar wire internally kat kar touch ho jaye.
Teesra pin Earth wire ke liye hota hai, jo leakage current ko earth mein bhej deta hai, taaki user ko shock na lage.
steps.math: Third pin = Earth = Safety from shock

worked_example.answer: The third pin is for the earth wire, which provides a low resistance path for leakage current to the ground, protecting the user from severe electric shocks.

common_mistakes.title: Thinking earth wire is for power
common_mistakes.explanation: Kuch log sochte hain ki earthing ke bina appliance on hi nahi hoga. Par 2-pin (Live, Neutral) se circuit complete ho jata hai aur device kaam karti hai. Earth sirf metallic body wale appliances me extreme safety feature hai.

recall_questions.q: What is the potential difference between the live wire and the neutral wire in India?
Which coloured wire is connected to the metallic body of electrical appliances?
What is the typical color of the earth wire insulation?

oa_questions.question: What is the function of an earth wire? Why is it necessary to earth metallic appliances?
oa_questions.answer: The earth wire provides a low resistance conducting path for the current. It is necessary to earth metallic appliances so that any leakage of current to the metallic body keeps its potential equal to that of the earth (zero), protecting the user from an electric shock.
